SM_RangeFloor.notes: Octagonal concrete/metal floor shell; tiled UV0, uniquely packed UV1. Top surface at Z=0.

SM_WallPanel_160.notes: Plain poured concrete wall, 1.6 m nominal length, 0.26 m thick, 2.8 m tall. No wall cap or coping.

SM_WallCorner_45.notes: Shared solid 45-degree outside corner infill; same concrete finish, no coping.

SM_BackstopPanel.notes: Replaceable painted impact surface; panel joints, fasteners and hit wear are texture.

SM_RobotTarget.notes: One static quadrupedal rabbit-like robotic training dummy; exactly four legs. Red target is painted UV texture. Reused four times. No rig/damage behaviour.

SM_TargetPad.notes: Thin, non-colliding target-position marker. Safety border is texture.

SM_LEDBar.notes: Shared light housing. Emissive is a texture; actual lights are placed separately.

SM_Conduit_160.notes: One 1.6 m conduit asset, reused horizontally and vertically with transforms.

SM_VentPanel.notes: Vent slats and screws are normal-map and base-colour details, not geometry.

SM_FiringBench.notes: 1.5 m repeatable bench module; each top has its own directional service-mat UV chart.

SM_ControlConsole.notes: Compact range-control screen; graphics and small buttons are atlas texture, not live gameplay UI.

SM_WeaponRack.notes: Open display rack; peg holes and fasteners are surface textures. Rifles are separate reusable props.

SM_DisplayRifle.notes: Non-functional decorative game prop: simplified silhouette only, not a manufacturing model.

SM_FloorMarkings.notes: One very-low-triangle marking sheet: firing line, numbered positions, and back grates.
